tex_content.html:
Corollary
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0099, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0100 1. Corollary 3.20\group harmonic-map-flow

If $(\M ^n,g)$ has strictly positive Ricci curvature, then $\mathrm{id}:(\M ^n,g)\to (\M ^n,\Rc (g))$ is a harmonic map.
